content.title: Chapter 14 - ANIMALS — Sec. 14-221. - Required.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person, firm, or corporation to maintain or to operate
               any kennel within the city without first having obtained a city kennel license therefor
               as required by this chapter.
(Code 1981, § 6-100; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998)
